capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the call regarding the stalled claim.
steps.expected_behavior: Speak in Hindi using Devanagari script, leaving English terms in Roman.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मैं insurance company से बोल रहा हूँ। क्या मेरी बात POL-1009 के policyholder से हो रही है? यह call आपके stalled claim intimation के बारे में है।
steps.planner_rationale: Initiating the outbound call and setting the context for the stalled claim intimation.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge identity and express time pressure.
steps.text: हाँ, मैं बोल रहा हूँ। मेरे accident claim में क्या problem है? मेरे पास सिर्फ दो minute हैं।
steps.clean_text: हाँ, मैं बोल रहा हूँ। मेरे accident claim में क्या problem है? मेरे पास सिर्फ दो minute हैं।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, मैं बोल रहा हूँ। मेरे accident claim में क्या problem है? मेरे पास सिर्फ नौ minute हैं।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the time pressure and ask for a verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely ask for a non-sensitive verification factor to establish identity.
steps.text: मैं जल्दी बताता हूँ sir. Security के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered pincode confirm कर सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: Before disclosing claim details, the agent must verify the caller's identity using a non-sensitive factor.

steps.text: मेरा pincode 400053 है। अब जल्दी बताइए。
steps.clean_text: मेरा pincode 400053 है। अब जल्दी बताइए।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा pincode 400053 है। अब जल्दी बताइए।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the verification tool with the correct reference ID and factor.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided their pincode, so the agent must verify it before proceeding.

steps.expected_behavior: Look up the policy to find the deductible and cover details.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to check policy details to disclose the deductible as required by BR_INS_04.

steps.purpose: Check what documents are pending for the accident claim.
steps.expected_behavior: Check eligibility to get the exact list of required documents.
steps.planner_rationale: To inform the user about pending documents, the agent must query the eligibility tool.

steps.purpose: State the deductible, required documents, and ask for the estimate to register the claim.
steps.expected_behavior: State the deductible from lookup_policy and the exact documents from check_claim_eligibility, then ask for the estimate amount.
steps.text: Sir, आपकी motor policy में 1000 rupees का deductible है। Process आगे बढ़ाने के लिए हमें Driving License और Police FIR चाहिए। Claim register करने के लिए repair estimate amount कितना है?
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfilling BR_INS_04 by stating the deductible, and BR_INS_03 by listing only the documents returned by the tool, while advancing the scenario to register the claim.

steps.purpose: Provide the estimate and ask for approval guarantee.
steps.text: Estimate 50000 rupees का है। मैं documents mail कर दूँगा। यह claim pass हो जाएगा ना?
steps.clean_text: Estimate 50000 rupees का है। मैं documents mail कर दूँगा। यह claim pass हो जाएगा ना?
steps.model_visible_text: Estimate 50000 rupees का है। मैं documents mail कर दूँगा। यह claim pass हो जाएगा ना?

steps.purpose: Register the claim with the provided estimate.
steps.expected_behavior: Call register_claim with the policy number, incident type, and the amount provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided the estimate, so the agent can now complete the claim registration.

steps.purpose: Provide the claim number, refuse to guarantee admissibility, and state the decision window.
steps.expected_behavior: Explicitly state that the claims team decides, refuse to guarantee approval, and provide the claim number and decision window.
steps.text: Sir, आपका claim register हो गया है, claim number CLM-9988 है। Documents आने के बाद claims team check करेगी। मैं claim pass होने की guarantee नहीं दे सकता, final decision उन्हीं का होगा। Decision window 7 days का है।
steps.planner_rationale: Adhering to BR_INS_01 by not prejudging the claim outcome, while fulfilling the terminal success condition of providing the claim number and decision window.

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.
